en.name: Confetti Success Animation
en.title: Confetti Success Animation: Burst Recipe
en.description: Lines, squares and dots burst from a tap, and a check seal pops with an echo outline on payment. Make it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
howto: On the Review tap at 2.65 s, send 6 elements from the tap point at -26, -78, -156, -128, -52 and -104 degrees: a white line with navy outline, a navy line, a blue line, a navy wavy line, a white dot and a blue square. They travel 96 to 120 px. Expand with expo.out over 0.3 s, drift 12 px linearly over 0.5 s and fade with power1.in over 0.16 s.

For payment, the Pay tap at 5.1 s turns the button into a disabled Sending state. At 5.45 s a 132 px scalloped blue seal pops from scale 0.6 to 1.1 with power3.out in 0.28 s, then to 1.0 with power2.inOut in 0.24 s. An echo outline scales 1 to 3 while fading from 0.6 to 0 over 0.6 s, and the check stroke draws in 0.24 s.

Press the copy button on the recipe page and paste it into Claude Code or Codex, or run npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent renders an MP4 with HyperFrames, or ports the GSAP timeline to your site with your own tap and payment screens.
faq: What is a confetti success animation?

A short burst of small shapes, such as strips, squares and dots, released at the moment an action succeeds, like a tap or a payment. The graphics appear only on the key action frame, so they mark the moment that matters.
Can I make a burst without a particle library?

Yes. Six elements are enough: send each from the contact point along a fixed angle with expo.out, then drift and fade. This recipe uses six elements travelling 96 to 120 px, which a handful of GSAP tweens can drive.
Is the Confetti Success Animation recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

zh.name: 撒花成功动画
zh.title: 撒花成功动画：点击与付款爆发配方
zh.description: 点击和付款的那一帧，线条、方块、圆点从接触点爆开，确认图标回弹弹出并扩散描边。用免费配方，让 Claude Code 或 Codex 做出来。
howto: 2.65 秒点击 Review 时，从点击位置向 -26°、-78°、-156°、-128°、-52°、-104° 六个方向发出六个元素：带深蓝描边的白线、深蓝线、蓝线、深蓝波浪线、白点和蓝色方块，行进 96 到 120px。用 expo.out 在 0.3 秒内展开，再线性漂移 12px 用时 0.5 秒，最后用 power1.in 在 0.16 秒内淡出。
付款时，5.1 秒点击 Pay，按钮变成禁用的 Sending 状态。5.45 秒一个 132px 的波浪边蓝色印章弹出：用 power3.out 在 0.28 秒内从 0.6 缩放到 1.1，再用 power2.inOut 在 0.24 秒内回到 1.0。同形的描边在 0.6 秒内从 1 倍放大到 3 倍，不透明度从 0.6 降到 0，对勾笔画用 0.24 秒画出。
在配方页点复制按钮，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以运行 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。智能体会用 HyperFrames 渲染 MP4，或者把 GSAP 时间线移植到你的网站，点击和付款界面换成你自己的。
faq: 在点击、付款这类操作成功的瞬间，放出一小团碎片图形，比如线条、方块和圆点。图形只在关键操作帧出现，用来标出重要的时刻。
不用粒子库能做出爆发效果吗？
可以。六个元素就够：每个元素从接触点出发，沿固定角度用 expo.out 展开，再漂移并淡出。这份配方用六个元素行进 96 到 120px，几个 GSAP 动画就能驱动。
撒花成功动画配方可以免费使用吗？
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
